subject: Commercial gating: Zephyr procurement + invoice requirements (next steps)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zephyrhealth.com>, Ella Johnson <ella.johnson@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial gating: Zephyr procurement + invoice requirements (next steps)

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement has what they need to move a pilot PO forward: 

1) Commercial path: you indicated procurement prefers a standard PO (Net 30) but finance may request Net 45 for pilots. Please confirm whether a Net 30 PO is acceptable or if we should prepare Net 45 paperwork.

2) Invoice format: your AP team requested an XML invoice sample and a PDF render. Attached a Sample_Invoice.xml and a one-page invoice example for formatting. Can you confirm the required fields (EIN/TIN, billing address, VAT registration number if applicable) and whether electronic delivery to procurement@zephyrhealth.com is sufficient?

3) Tax & VAT: you mentioned UK entity work later; for the US pilot, do you need us to include any specific tax withholding language or a tax-exempt certificate?

4) Purchase route: PO vs. marketplace — you said marketplace billing would be faster but you need internal approvals. Please flag whether procurement prefers us to create a marketplace listing or accept a direct PO.

Next steps I propose:
- Samir/Ella: confirm Net terms and billing address (see questions inline).
- Ben: loop in legal for a one-page SOW and to confirm standard pilot terms.
- Once confirmed, Procurement can return a completed PO (we can accept PDF/scan) or signal marketplace interest and we’ll provide the marketplace flow.

Attachments: Zephyr_PO_template.pdf (blank PO to speed sign-off), Sample_Invoice.xml, Redwood_SOW_brief.pdf

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ella Johnson <ella.johnson@zephyrhealth.com>, procurement@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial gating: Zephyr procurement + invoice requirements (next steps)

Kim — thanks for the clear summary. A few answers from procurement + questions from finance below: 

- Net terms: finance prefers Net 45 for pilot contracts <20k, otherwise Net 30. Pilot expected to be ~12k over 4 weeks so Net 45 would be our preference. Is Redwood able to accept Net 45 for the pilot?

- Billing address: 
  Zephyr Health Inc.
  Accounts Payable
  280 Harbor Drive, Suite 700
  San Mateo, CA 94401

- Invoice delivery: procurement@zephyrhealth.com is the correct mailbox. PDF sent as attachment is fine; if you can also provide an XML version that maps to our Aria AP system that would speed routing.

- Required fields: EIN (94-1234567), billing reference (PO#), remit-to, and a line-level breakdown of tokens/units or hourly equivalent. Please confirm the SKU/line format you use so we can map.

- Tax: for US entity no VAT. We may request a tax-exempt certificate if the use case qualifies; we’ll confirm by Thursday.

Marketplace: procurement is open but needs pricing parity and the ability to get a PO and invoicing to our AP system. If Redwood can publish a marketplace SKU that still allows Zephyr to pay via PO, that could be ideal — but we understand not all marketplaces allow that flow.

Can Ben / Redwood legal draft a minimal SOW with Net 45 clearly stated if that’s acceptable? We can then route the PO.

Thanks,
Samir

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zephyrhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial gating: Zephyr procurement + invoice requirements (next steps)

Samir — appreciate the details. We can accept Net 45 for this pilot; Ben from Redwood Sales (me) confirming. A couple implementation notes: 

- Invoice structure: we’ll provide both PDF and the XML file populated with the line-level SKU detail. For this pilot we typically send one "usage" line with a units/token estimate and an agreed fixed pilot fee so your AP has a simple line mapping. Example SKU: RDW-PILOT-1. If you prefer token-level billing we can provide a CSV export as well.

- PO template: attached Zephyr_PO_template.pdf — happy to accept a scanned PO. If your AP needs the PO in a specific XML schema, send an example and Priyom will populate it.

- Tax-exempt: noted — we’ll wait for confirmation.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Priyom: prepare a one-page SOW with Net 45 and populate the Sample_Invoice.xml with the agreed SKU and your billing address.
- Kim: I’ll follow up to confirm marketplace vs direct PO once we hear back on whether your procurement can accept Net 45 on the marketplace route.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Hi Samir / procurement team — attaching the populated Sample_Invoice.xml and a one-page SOW (Redwood_SOW_brief.pdf) that reflects Net 45 pilot terms and the billing address you provided. A quick checklist for your AP to confirm: 

- Does the Sample_Invoice.xml map cleanly into your Aria fields (EIN, PO#, remit-to)? If not, please paste a minimal XML schema your system expects and we will reformat.
- Confirm whether a scanned PDF PO is acceptable or if you need a machine-readable PO XML.
- If Zephyr provides a tax-exempt certificate, please send it to procurement@zephyrhealth.com and cc me so we can attach it to the invoice.

If everything looks good we can start the pilot on Monday following receipt of the signed PO. Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if procurement would like to walk through the XML mapping.

Best,
